lines.text: Two square corners, and every other corner is one hundred sixty degrees.
lines.caption: Two square corners, and every other corner is one hundred sixty degrees.

lines.text: Don't add up angles. Go for a walk!
lines.caption: Don't add up angles. Go for a walk!

lines.text: Two corners are ninety degrees. All the others are one hundred sixty.
lines.caption: Two corners are ninety degrees. All the others are one hundred sixty.

lines.text: How many sides does it have?
lines.caption: How many sides does it have?

lines.text: Walk around the outside. Your turns always add up to three hundred sixty degrees.
lines.caption: Walk around the outside. Your turns always add up to three hundred sixty degrees.

lines.text: A square corner turns you ninety. A one hundred sixty corner turns you only twenty.
lines.caption: A square corner turns you ninety. A one hundred sixty corner turns you only twenty.

lines.text: Square corners use up one hundred eighty. The rest comes in turns of twenty: nine corners!
lines.caption: Square corners use up one hundred eighty. The rest comes in turns of twenty: nine corners!

lines.text: Nine plus the two square corners is eleven sides!
lines.caption: Nine plus the two square corners is eleven sides!

lines.text: Nearly flat corners take lots of sides to go around.
lines.caption: Nearly flat corners take lots of sides to go around.

lines.text: Want to see why? The full lesson has two neat ways and every trap.
